children: Shares of Siemens Energy India Ltd. surged as much as 10% in reaction to their fourth quarter results on Thursday, November 26. The results were reported after market hours on Wednesday and were strong across parameters when compared to the same quarter last year.

For the fourth quarter, Siemens Energy India reported revenue growth of 30.5% from last year to ₹3,452.6 crore, while its Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortisation (EBITDA) stood at ₹823.2 crore, a growth of 71.6% from the year-ago perod.

EBITDA margin also expanded by over 500 basis points to 23.8% from 18.1% last year due to higher contribution of the high margin power transmission segment to the revenue mix. During the quarter, the Power Transmission segment contributed to 64% of the overall topline to 51% from last year.

The company's order inflow has been surpassing its quarterly base run-rate of ₹3,000 crore to ₹3,300 crore for the last five years, coming in at ₹4,514 crore from the September quarter, a growth of 92% from the base quarter. This has taken the total order book size to ₹20,362 crore, which is a growth of 25.6% from the year-ago period.

Power transmission segment reported 63% revenue growth during the quarter, while power generation revenue declined from last year by 4.1%. However, margins for both these segments expanded from last year.
Siemens Energy India Shares Are A Buy Or Sell?

JPMorgan has maintained a "neutral" rating with a price target of ₹3,600. Looking ahead, JPMorgan noted that leading demand indicators and ongoing capacity expansions across the power equipment sector point to a potential further increase in order inflows over the next 12 to 18 months.

Nomura has also maintained its "neutral" rating on the stock with a price target of ₹3,944. The global investment banking firm stated that the worst of the margin headwinds are likely behind the company, supported by a healthy demand outlook and early signs of a pickup in private capital expenditure across select segments.
UBS continues to remain optimistic on the stock with a "buy" rating and target of ₹5,000.

19 analysts have coverage on Siemens Energy India, of which 14 of them have a "buy" rating, two say "hold", and three have a "sell" rating. The consensus estimates of price targets implies an upside potential of 31%from current levels.
Shares of Siemens Energy India are trading 8.9% higher on Thursday at ₹3,231.6. The stock has risen 17% in the last one month, extending their year-to-date advance to 28%.

title: Siemens Energy India shares surge 10% after strong Q4 operating performance; Check upside potential
